items.title: Tarris Reed Jr. on learning from the example Jordan McLaughlin sets:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Tarris Reed Jr. on learning from the example Jordan McLaughlin sets:

"Seeing J-Mac, especially in Utah, coming fresh off the bench and having an instant impact, and you just (go), 'Oh, man, I'm going to do that. I got to be ready like J Mac.' He shows up every day."

items.title: The always reliable Jordan McLaughlin on his talent for producing quality work in limited minutes:
items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
The always reliable Jordan McLaughlin on his talent for producing quality work in limited minutes:

"It's just trusting in your work, trusting your work. Off days, they're not really off days. So just coming in every single day, making sure I'm ready to go." #Spurs
